sourceScope: Only files directly in E:/Downloads/Music and directly in E:/Downloads/Music/reel; no other subfolders.
audioPolicy: Full, byte-identical tracks copied to the downloadable library; download originals preserved. Only 0-30 seconds decoded for style assessment.
method: Local quantized CLAP embeddings for 0-10, 10-20 and 20-30 seconds at mono 48 kHz. Normalize and average the three audio embeddings, rank by cosine similarity to style descriptions, and average scores across alternate takes for a consistent shelf. Scores are relative similarity, not probabilities. No claim of listening or full-track genre verification.
limitations: Opening passages may differ from later sections; style labels are model-assisted estimates. The Last Command and The Last Command II have sung words in their embedded lyrics; stripped metadata cannot establish the absence of vocals elsewhere.
